figures.name: Odin

ability.name: All-Father's Ravens
ability.description: Look at all enemy cards; choose one to lose 3 stats of your choice.

figures.description: One-eyed Allfather who sacrificed himself on the World Tree to gain the runes and all wisdom.

figures.name: Thor

ability.name: Mjolnir Strike
ability.description: Deal 7 damage; enemy cannot use magic abilities next turn.

figures.description: Red-bearded thunder god whose hammer Mjolnir always returns and who protects humanity from giants.

figures.name: Loki

ability.name: Shape Thief
ability.description: Copy one enemy ability and use it immediately against them.

figures.description: Shapeshifting trickster god whose schemes entertain and endanger the gods in equal measure.

figures.name: Freya

ability.name: Valkyrie's Claim
ability.description: Choose one fallen ally per battle; resurrect them at half HP.

figures.description: Powerful goddess of love and war who receives half of all battle-slain heroes in her hall Sessrumnir.

figures.name: Frigg

ability.name: Weave of Fate
ability.description: Look at enemy hand; remove one card of your choice from play.

figures.description: Queen of Asgard who knows the fate of all beings but keeps her knowledge in silence.

figures.name: Baldur

ability.name: Invulnerability
ability.description: Negate all damage for 1 turn; cannot be targeted by dark-alignment cards.

figures.description: Beloved god of light made invulnerable to all things except mistletoe — his one fatal weakness.

figures.name: Tyr

ability.name: Binding Sacrifice
ability.description: Permanently disable one enemy's most powerful ability; this card loses 1 hand.

figures.description: One-handed god of justice who sacrificed his hand to bind the wolf Fenrir for the safety of all.

figures.name: Heimdall

ability.name: Gjallarhorn
ability.description: Reveal all hidden enemy cards; allies gain +2 speed for 2 turns.

figures.description: Ever-watchful guardian of Bifrost who can see and hear across all nine realms.

figures.name: Hel

ability.name: Half-Life Aura
ability.description: Drain 2 HP per turn from all enemies as long as this card is in play.

figures.description: Half-living half-dead ruler of Niflheim who receives all who die of illness, age or dishonor.

figures.name: Skadi

ability.name: Frostbound Hunt
ability.description: Deal 4 damage and slow enemy speed by 3 for 2 turns.

figures.description: Fierce giantess-goddess of winter and hunting who skis across frozen mountains in pursuit of prey.

figures.name: Fenrir

ability.name: Chain-Breaker
ability.description: Destroy one buff or binding effect; deal 5 damage to all enemies.

figures.description: Monstrous wolf son of Loki bound by the silk-like chain Gleipnir, destined to swallow Odin at Ragnarok.

figures.name: Jormungandr

ability.name: World Serpent Venom
ability.description: Poison all enemies for 3 turns; each loses 2 HP per turn.

figures.description: The Midgard Serpent that encircles the world ocean, locked in eternal enmity with Thor.

figures.name: Surtur

ability.name: Twilight Inferno
ability.description: Deal 5 fire damage to all enemies; set the battlefield alight for 2 turns.

figures.description: Fire giant lord of Muspelheim whose sword will consume the world in the final battle of Ragnarok.

figures.name: Sigurd

ability.name: Dragon's Bane
ability.description: Deal 8 damage to monster/creature types; gain 1 stack of Cursed Gold.

figures.description: Greatest Norse hero who slew the dragon Fafnir, bathed in its blood and understood the language of birds.

figures.name: Brynhildr

ability.name: Valkyrie Shield-Wall
ability.description: Grant all allies +3 defense for 2 turns; redirect one attack to this card.

figures.description: Greatest of the Valkyries, cursed to sleep in a ring of fire until awakened by the hero Sigurd.

figures.name: Ymir

ability.name: Primordial Flesh
ability.description: When destroyed, deal 4 damage to all cards on the field as the world reshapes.

figures.description: First frost giant from whose enormous body Odin and his brothers shaped the entire cosmos.

figures.name: Nidhogg

ability.name: Root Gnaw
ability.description: Reduce one enemy's max HP by 3 permanently; restore 2 HP to this card.

figures.description: Ancient dragon that endlessly gnaws at the roots of Yggdrasil, slowly weakening the World Tree.

figures.name: Sleipnir

ability.name: Eight-Legged Stride
ability.description: This card can dodge the first attack each turn; move any ally to any position.

figures.description: Odin's eight-legged horse, born of Loki's shapeshifting, fastest creature in all nine realms.

figures.name: Angrboda

ability.name: Mother of Monsters
ability.description: Summon one random monster ally with 5/5/5/5/5 stats for 2 turns.

figures.description: Iron Wood giantess and Loki's consort who mothered Fenrir, Jormungandr and Hel.

figures.name: Ratatoskr

ability.name: Slanderous Whisper
ability.description: Cause two enemy cards to attack each other for 1 turn.

figures.description: Squirrel that scurries up and down Yggdrasil carrying insulting messages between eagle and dragon.
